response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile hands-on engineer with a long track record across web, mobile, and infrastructure projects, but his profile does not match the director-level AI strategy scope of this role. He lacks demonstrated AI product/platform leadership, cloud strategy experience, or a track record advising strategic customers/partners, and his current AI-related work (MCP tooling) only began in 2025 with no depth shown.
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, hands-on engineering experience across multiple languages and platforms
Demonstrated entrepreneurial spirit via founding and maintaining an open-source GIS platform since 2016
Track record of teaching, mentoring, and public speaking (workshops, conference talks)
concerns: No evidence of AI/ML expertise, AI product leadership, or advanced AI-related degree
Career trajectory shows Senior/Staff-level IC roles, not Director/Principal-level strategic leadership
No experience advising strategic customers/partners or driving cloud/AI go-to-market strategy
